item.title: Artemis 2 moon rocket rolls back to the shop | Space photo of the day Feb. 27, 2026
item.description: NASA brought its mega moon rocket back into the shop for repairs on Feb. 25, 2026, just as the sun was setting over the Florida Space Coast.

item.title: Herhoter Galaxy star projector review
item.description: With a small form factor and a seriously low price, the Herhoter Galaxy star projector is a great buy for anyone wanting nebula projections on a budget.

item.title: The total lunar eclipse on March 3 will be the last until New Year's Eve 2028
item.description: After this 'blood moon,' our natural satellite will not fully disappear into Earth's shadow again for nearly three years — until a rare trifecta of total lunar eclipses in 2028–29 ends the drought.

item.title: Lego Star Wars AT-AT 75440 review
item.description: One of 2026's must-have Lego Star Wars sets — the excellent mid-sized AT-AT model.

item.title: NASA's Artemis 3 astronauts won't land on the moon after all. 'This is just not the right pathway forward.'
item.description: NASA is changing its plans to return astronauts to the moon, and redrawing the architecture for how the Artemis missions will look moving forward.

item.title: If Godzilla attacked, could we survive? We asked the experts
item.description: Let's say Godzilla exists and walks among us like in Monarch: Legacy of Monsters. Could humans actually stop him, or even survive? We spoke to the experts to find out.

item.title: The US Air Force's latest X-plane looks like a missile — that shoots other missiles
item.description: The U.S. military is developing a new experimental aircraft known as the X-68A and looks a lot like a cruise missile that is also capable of launching its own missiles.

item.title: Nostrovia! We finally got our 1st look at Apple TV's 'Star City,' the Soviet 'For All Mankind' spinoff
item.description: See how the space race evolved from the other side in this new sci-fi series coming in May

item.title: Apollo moon rocks may have finally solved an old lunar mystery
item.description: A new analysis of Apollo moon samples reveals insight into the history of the lunar magnetic field.

item.title: February finale: SpaceX wraps up month with three Starlink launches this week
item.description: Two Falcon 9 launches from Florida and one from California deployed 83 Starlink satellites into low Earth orbit, wrapping up February 2026 for the SpaceX network.
